topic: Carrying a balance at twenty two percent vs a zero percent transfer paid off inside the window (Leroy vs Jacqueline)

scenes.narration: A zero percent transfer only works if you beat the clock. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a credit card with a timer reading EIGHTEEN MONTHS and a zero percent tag, comic burst banner reads BEAT THE CLOCK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leroy and Jacqueline both owe eight thousand dollars at twenty two percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split clinic panel of man leroy and woman jacqueline each holding a statement reading EIGHT THOUSAND AT TWENTY TWO PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both get an offer. Zero percent for eighteen months, three percent fee.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a mailer reading ZERO PERCENT FOR EIGHTEEN MONTHS, THREE PERCENT FEE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leroy ignores it. Fees feel like a trick.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man leroy tossing the mailer, a thought bubble reads FEES ARE A TRICK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He pays two hundred fifty a month and watches interest eat most of it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a payment bar with a big red slice labeled INTEREST and a tiny slice labeled PRINCIPAL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Four years and thirty nine hundred dollars of interest later, he is done.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a clipboard reading INTEREST PAID THIRTY NINE HUNDRED, a calendar showing four years, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jacqueline transfers the balance and pays the two hundred forty dollar fee.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman jacqueline completing a transfer, a receipt reads FEE TWO HUNDRED FORTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She divides eight thousand two forty by eighteen and autopays four sixty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a calculation reading EIGHT THOUSAND TWO FORTY DIVIDED BY EIGHTEEN EQUALS FOUR SIXTY, an autopay screen, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She does not use the card for a single new purchase.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman jacqueline placing the card in a drawer with a lock, a tag reads PAYOFF ONLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Month seventeen, the balance hits zero. Interest paid, zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman jacqueline celebrating beside a statement reading BALANCE ZERO, a calendar reads MONTH SEVENTEEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leroy paid thirty nine hundred in interest. Jacqueline paid a two forty fee.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man leroy beside a tall interest bar, woman jacqueline beside a tiny fee bar, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Transfer, divide by the months, autopay, and finish early. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading FINISH BEFORE THE CLOCK, a healthy zero balance chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
